ops:
reviews and publishes the draft.
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+']

permissions:
  contents: write # push the major tag, create the release
  pull-requests: read # read the release notes from the pull request

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/chec
